LeBrunSalamon.Construction.Lines.VelocityAdditionFamily.conePoint_coordinates {I : Type} [Fintype I] (S T : Set (I → ℂ))
  (hS : EquationClosed S) (hT : EquationClosed T) (omega : I → I → ℂ)
  (p :
    PointsOver ComplexBase (𝟙 ComplexBase) (↑(nonorthogonalOpen S T omega))
      ((nonorthogonalOpen S T omega).ι ≫ affineBaseMap (ProductRing S T))) :
  ∃ a b,
    ∃ (_ : a ∈ S) (_ : b ∈ T),
      ConePairing.pairing omega a b ≠ 0 ∧ ↑p ≫ nonorthogonalAddition S T omega = coordinatePoint (a + b)
